// ==================== Tab 切换 ====================
try {
  var tabBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
  var tabContents = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content');
  tabBtns.forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      tabBtns.forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('tab-active'); b.classList.add('text-slate-400'); });
      btn.classList.add('tab-active'); btn.classList.remove('text-slate-400');
      tabContents.forEach(function(c){ c.classList.add('hidden'); });
      var target = document.getElementById('tab-' + btn.dataset.tab);
      if (target) target.classList.remove('hidden');
      setTimeout(function(){ window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); }, 60);
    });
  });
} catch(e){ console.error('Tab init failed', e); }

// ==================== 通用工具 ====================
async function fetchWithProxy(url, options){
  options = options || {};
  try {
    var res = await fetch(url, options);
    if (res.ok) return res;
    throw new Error('direct ' + res.status);
  } catch(e){
    var proxyUrl = 'https://corsproxy.io/?url=' + encodeURIComponent(url);
    var r2 = await fetch(proxyUrl, options);
    if (!r2.ok) throw new Error('proxy ' + r2.status);
    return r2;
  }
}
function toTencentCode(code){ if (/^[65]/.test(code)) return 'sh' + code; return 'sz' + code; }
function classifyInstrument(code){
  if (/^[15]\d{5}$/.test(code)) return 'etf';
  if (/^[603]\d{5}$/.test(code)) return 'stock';
  return 'fund';
}
function levelOf(s){ return s >= 60 ? 'green' : s >= 40 ? 'yellow' : 'red'; }
function levelMeta(l){ return { green:{dot:'dot-green',text:'text-green-400'}, yellow:{dot:'dot-yellow',text:'text-yellow-400'}, red:{dot:'dot-red',text:'text-red-400'} }[l]; }
function avg(arr){ return arr.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0)/arr.length; }

// ==================== 实时评分计算 ====================
async function computeLiveScore(){
  var r = { valuation: 55, capital: 35, sentiment: 40, technical: 50, total: 42 };
  try {
    var end = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
    var start = new Date(Date.now() - 400*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
    var rows = await fetchTencentKlineSegment('sh000001', start, end);
    if (rows.length >= 20){
      var closes = rows.map(function(k){ return k.close; });
      var cur = closes[closes.length-1];
      var ma20 = avg(closes.slice(-20));
      var ma250 = closes.length >= 250 ? avg(closes.slice(-250)) : null;
      var s = 50;
      if (ma250){
        if (cur > ma20 && ma20 > ma250) s = 80;
        else if (cur > ma250 && cur < ma20) s = 60;
        else if (cur < ma250 && cur > ma20) s = 40;
        else s = 20;
      } else s = cur > ma20 ? 60 : 40;
      r.technical = s;
    }
  } catch(e){}
  try {
    var res = await fetchWithProxy('https://qt.gtimg.cn/q=sh000001');
    var buf = await res.arrayBuffer();
    var text = new TextDecoder('gbk').decode(buf);
    var m = text.match(/="(.+)"/);
    if (m){
      var f = m[1].split('~');
      var pe = parseFloat(f[39]); var pb = parseFloat(f[46]);
      if (!isNaN(pe) && pe > 0){
        if (pe <= 12) r.valuation = 80;
        else if (pe <= 15) r.valuation = 65;
        else if (pe <= 20) r.valuation = 50;
        else if (pe <= 25) r.valuation = 35;
        else r.valuation = 25;
      }
      if (!isNaN(pb) && pb > 0){
        if (pb <= 1.0) r.valuation = Math.min(90, r.valuation + 10);
        else if (pb >= 3.0) r.valuation = Math.max(10, r.valuation - 10);
      }
      var amtWan = parseFloat(f[37]);
      if (!isNaN(amtWan) && amtWan > 0){
        var yi = amtWan / 10000;
        if (yi >= 5000) r.sentiment = 75;
        else if (yi >= 3000) r.sentiment = 60;
        else if (yi >= 1500) r.sentiment = 50;
        else if (yi >= 800) r.sentiment = 35;
        else r.sentiment = 20;
      }
    }
  } catch(e){}
  r.capital = 35;
  r.total = Math.round(r.valuation*0.3 + r.capital*0.25 + r.sentiment*0.25 + r.technical*0.2);
  r.total = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, r.total));
  return r;
}

// ==================== 19项信号实时数据 ====================
async function fetchSignalData(){
  var sig = {};
  try {
    var res = await fetchWithProxy('https://qt.gtimg.cn/q=sh000001');
    var buf = await res.arrayBuffer();
    var text = new TextDecoder('gbk').decode(buf);
    var m = text.match(/="(.+)"/);
    if (m){
      var f = m[1].split('~');
      var amtWan = parseFloat(f[37]);
      if (!isNaN(amtWan) && amtWan > 0){
        sig.turnover = (amtWan/10000).toFixed(2) + '万亿';
      }
    }
  } catch(e){}
  try {
    var compRes = await fetchWithProxy('https://push2.eastmoney.com/api/qt/clist/get?pn=1&pz=300&po=1&np=1&fltt=2&invt=2&fid=f3&fs=b:MK0300&fields=f12,f14,f2,f3,f39,f46');
    var j = await compRes.json();
    if (j.data && j.data.diff){
      var list = j.data.diff, total = 0, broken = 0;
      list.forEach(function(it){
        var pb = parseFloat(it.f46);
        if (!isNaN(pb) && pb > 0){ total++; if (pb < 1) broken++; }
      });
      if (total > 0){
        sig.brokenNet = (broken/total*100).toFixed(2) + '%';
      }
      var peList = list.map(function(i){ return parseFloat(i.f39); }).filter(function(v){ return !isNaN(v) && v > 0; });
      if (peList.length > 0){
        peList.sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
        sig.hs300PeMedian = peList[Math.floor(peList.length/2)];
      }
    }
  } catch(e){}
  try {
    var mRes = await fetchWithProxy('https://datacenter-web.eastmoney.com/api/data/v1/get?reportName=RPTA_WEB_RZRQ_GGMX&columns=ALL&pageSize=1&sortColumns=DATE&sortTypes=-1');
    var mj = await mRes.json();
    if (mj.result && mj.result.data && mj.result.data.length > 0){
      var row = mj.result.data[0];
      var bal = row.RZRQYE || row.RZYE;
      if (bal){
        sig.marginBalance = (bal/1e12).toFixed(2) + '万亿';
        sig.marginDate = row.DATE ? row.DATE.slice(0,10) : '';
      }
    }
  } catch(e){}
  try {
    var endD = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
    var startD = new Date(Date.now() - 60*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
    var kl = await fetchTencentKlineSegment('sh000001', startD, endD);
    if (kl.length >= 30){
      var cls = kl.map(function(k){ return k.close; });
      var c = cls[cls.length-1];
      var ma30 = avg(cls.slice(-30));
      sig.ma30Position = c > ma30 ? '上证在30日线上方' : '上证在30日线下方';
    }
  } catch(e){}
  return sig;
}

function updateSignalUI(sig){
  if (!sig) return;
  if (sig.turnover){
    ['sig-turnover','sig-turnover-confirm'].forEach(function(id){
      var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = sig.turnover;
    });
  }
  if (sig.brokenNet){
    var bn = document.getElementById('sig-broken-net');
    if (bn){ bn.textContent = sig.brokenNet; bn.title = '数据来源：沪深300成分股代理'; }
  }
  if (sig.marginBalance){
    var mr = document.getElementById('sig-margin-rebound');
    if (mr){ mr.textContent = sig.marginBalance + (sig.marginDate ? ' (' + sig.marginDate + ')' : ''); mr.title = 'T+1披露'; }
    var mh = document.getElementById('sig-margin-high'); if (mh) mh.textContent = sig.marginBalance;
    var md = document.getElementById('sig-margin-drop');
    if (md) md.textContent = '-20%';
  }
  if (sig.ma30Position){
    var ma = document.getElementById('sig-ma30');
    if (ma){ ma.textContent = sig.ma30Position; ma.title = '代理指标：上证指数30日均线位置'; }
  }
  var st = document.getElementById('sig-score-take'); if (st) st.textContent = MARKET_SNAPSHOT.score;
  if (sig.hs300PeMedian != null){
    var hp = document.getElementById('sig-hs300-pe-take');
    if (hp){ var lbl = sig.hs300PeMedian <= 12 ? '低估' : sig.hs300PeMedian <= 18 ? '中性' : '偏高'; hp.textContent = 'PE中位 ' + sig.hs300PeMedian.toFixed(1) + ' (' + lbl + ')'; hp.title = '沪深300成分股PE中位数'; }
  }
}

// ==================== 实时指数拉取 ====================
async function fetchLiveIndices(){
  var codes = { sh000001:'上证指数', sh000300:'沪深300', sh000905:'中证500', sz399006:'创业板指', sh000688:'科创50' };
  var indices = {}, ok = 0;
  for (var code in codes){
    try {
      var res = await fetch('https://qt.gtimg.cn/q=' + code);
      if (!res.ok) continue;
      var buf = await res.arrayBuffer();
      var text = new TextDecoder('gbk').decode(buf);
      var m = text.match(/="(.+)"/);
      if (!m) continue;
      var f = m[1].split('~');
      if (f.length < 33) continue;
      indices[code] = { name: f[1]||codes[code], price: parseFloat(f[3])||null, changePct: parseFloat(f[32])||null, time: f[30]||null };
      ok++;
    } catch(e){}
  }
  if (ok === 0) return false;
  SNAPSHOT_INDICES = indices;

  try {
    var live = await computeLiveScore();
    MARKET_SNAPSHOT.score = live.total;
    MARKET_FUND_ENV.marketScore = live.total;
    var sub = document.getElementById('ov-sub-scores');
    if (sub) sub.textContent = '估值 ' + live.valuation + ' · 资金 ' + live.capital + ' · 情绪 ' + live.sentiment + ' · 技术 ' + live.technical;
  } catch(e){}

  try {
    var sig = await fetchSignalData();
    updateSignalUI(sig);
  } catch(e){}

  updateSnapshotBadge(new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10), '实时计算', 'auto');
  updateSnapshotUI();
  return true;
}

function updateSnapshotBadge(date, updatedAt, source){
  var el = document.getElementById('snapshot-date-badge'); if (!el) return;
  var lbl = source === 'auto' ? '自动' : 'builtin';
  el.textContent = '数据 ' + (date||'—') + ' · ' + lbl;
  el.className = 'text-[10px] border rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 ' + (source === 'auto' ? 'text-green-400 border-green-700/50' : 'text-slate-400 border-slate-600');
  if (updatedAt) el.title = updatedAt;
}

function updateSnapshotUI(){
  var score = MARKET_SNAPSHOT.score;
  var el = document.getElementById('ov-score'); if (el) el.textContent = score;
  var tone, range, fill;
  if (score < 30){ tone = '冰点'; range = '0–30 区间'; fill = 20; }
  else if (score < 55){ tone = '偏冷'; range = '30–55 区间'; fill = 42; }
  else if (score < 70){ tone = '中性'; range = '55–70 区间'; fill = 62; }
  else if (score < 85){ tone = '偏热'; range = '70–85 区间'; fill = 78; }
  else { tone = '过热'; range = '85–100 区间'; fill = 92; }
  var toneEl = document.getElementById('ov-tone'); if (toneEl) toneEl.textContent = tone;
  var rangeEl = document.getElementById('ov-range'); if (rangeEl) rangeEl.textContent = range;
  var fillEl = document.getElementById('ov-gauge-fill'); if (fillEl) fillEl.style.width = fill + '%';
  var hdr = document.getElementById('hdr-tone');
  if (hdr){
    var posMap = { '冰点':'60–80%', '偏冷':'40–60%', '中性':'30–50%', '偏热':'20–40%', '过热':'0–20%' };
    hdr.textContent = tone + ' · 仓位 ' + posMap[tone];
  }
  var posEl = document.getElementById('ov-pos');
  if (posEl){
    var posMap2 = { '冰点':[60,80], '偏冷':[40,60], '中性':[30,50], '偏热':[20,40], '过热':[0,20] };
    var pr = posMap2[tone]; posEl.textContent = pr[0] + '–' + pr[1] + '%';
    MARKET_SNAPSHOT.positionRange = pr;
  }
  var stopEl = document.getElementById('ov-stop'); if (stopEl) stopEl.textContent = '上证跌破 ' + MARKET_SNAPSHOT.stopLoss;
  var takeEl = document.getElementById('ov-take'); if (takeEl) takeEl.textContent = '评分回升至 ' + MARKET_SNAPSHOT.takeProfitScore + '+ 分批减仓';
  var sp = document.getElementById('strat-pos'); if (sp) sp.textContent = MARKET_SNAPSHOT.positionRange[0] + '–' + MARKET_SNAPSHOT.positionRange[1] + '%';
  var ss = document.getElementById('strat-stop'); if (ss) ss.textContent = '上证跌破 ' + MARKET_SNAPSHOT.stopLoss + ' 减仓至30%以下';
  var st = document.getElementById('strat-take'); if (st) st.textContent = '评分回升至 ' + MARKET_SNAPSHOT.takeProfitScore + '+，每周减仓10–15%';
  var sc = document.getElementById('strat-score'); if (sc) sc.textContent = score + ' ' + tone;
  var dh = document.getElementById('dec-score-hint'); if (dh) dh.textContent = '基于评分 ' + score;

  Object.keys(SNAPSHOT_INDICES).forEach(function(code){
    var d = SNAPSHOT_INDICES[code];
    var pe = document.querySelector('[data-idx="' + code + '-price"]');
    var ce = document.querySelector('[data-idx="' + code + '-chg"]');
    if (pe && d.price != null) pe.textContent = Number(d.price).toFixed(2);
    if (ce && d.changePct != null){
      ce.textContent = (d.changePct >= 0 ? '+' : '') + Number(d.changePct).toFixed(2) + '%';
      ce.className = 'text-right pr-4 num-font ' + (d.changePct >= 0 ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-green-400');
    }
  });
  var timeEl = document.getElementById('idx-snapshot-time');
  if (timeEl && Object.keys(SNAPSHOT_INDICES).length){
    var first = Object.values(SNAPSHOT_INDICES)[0];
    if (first && first.time) timeEl.textContent = '· ' + first.time;
  }
  try {
    if (chartInstances['chart-gauge']) chartInstances['chart-gauge'].setOption({ series: [{ data: [{ value: score }] }] });
  } catch(e){}
}

// ==================== ECharts ====================
var chartInstances = {};
function initChart(id, option){
  var el = document.getElementById(id); if (!el || typeof echarts === 'undefined') return;
  if (chartInstances[id]) chartInstances[id].dispose();
  var c = echarts.init(el, null, { renderer: 'canvas' });
  c.setOption(option); chartInstances[id] = c;
}

// ==================== 查询历史 ====================
var HISTORY_KEY = 'ashare_query_history_v1';
var HISTORY_MAX = 8;
function loadHistory(){ try { var raw = localStorage.getItem(HISTORY_KEY); return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : []; } catch(e){ return []; } }
function saveHistory(code, name, type){
  if (!code || !/^\d{6}$/.test(code)) return;
  var arr = loadHistory().filter(function(i){return i.code !== code;});
  arr.unshift({ code:code, name:name||code, type:type||'', ts:Date.now() });
  if (arr.length > HISTORY_MAX) arr = arr.slice(0, HISTORY_MAX);
  try { localStorage.setItem(HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(arr)); } catch(e){}
  renderHistory();
}
function removeHistory(code){
  var arr = loadHistory().filter(function(i){return i.code !== code;});
  try { localStorage.setItem(HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(arr)); } catch(e){}
  renderHistory();
}
function clearHistory(){ try { localStorage.removeItem(HISTORY_KEY); } catch(e){} renderHistory(); }
function renderHistory(){
  var el = document.getElementById('query-history'); if (!el) return;
  var arr = loadHistory();
  if (!arr.length){ el.classList.add('hidden'); el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  el.classList.remove('hidden');
  var map = { etf:'ETF', stock:'股', fund:'基' };
  var items = arr.map(function(it){
    var lbl = map[it.type] || '';
    return '<div class="history-item flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1.5 rounded bg-slate-800/60 hover:bg-slate-700/60 cursor-pointer transition text-[11px]" data-code="' + it.code + '">' +
      '<span class="text-blue-400 font-mono shrink-0">' + it.code + '</span>' +
      '<span class="text-slate-300 truncate max-w-[80px]">' + (it.name||'') + '</span>' +
      (lbl ? '<span class="text-[9px] px-1 rounded bg-slate-700 text-slate-400 shrink-0">' + lbl + '</span>' : '') +
      '<button class="history-remove text-slate-600 hover:text-red-400 shrink-0 ml-0.5" data-code="' + it.code + '">×</button></div>';
  }).join('');
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2"><span class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">最近查询</span><button id="history-clear-btn" class="text-[10px] text-slate-600 hover:text-red-400">清空</button></div><div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">' + items + '</div>';
  el.querySelectorAll('.history-item').forEach(function(node){
    node.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      if (e.target.classList.contains('history-remove')) return;
      var input = document.getElementById('universal-input');
      if (input) input.value = node.dataset.code;
      runUniversalQuery(node.dataset.code);
    });
  });
  el.querySelectorAll('.history-remove').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); removeHistory(btn.dataset.code); });
  });
  var cb = document.getElementById('history-clear-btn'); if (cb) cb.addEventListener('click', clearHistory);
}

// ==================== 基金/股票查询 ====================
var universalInput = document.getElementById('universal-input');
var universalBtn = document.getElementById('universal-btn');
var queryHint = document.getElementById('query-hint');
var diagResultEl = document.getElementById('fund-diag-result');
var analysisEl = document.getElementById('instrument-analysis');
var historyCard = document.getElementById('history-chart-card');
var historyTitle = document.getElementById('history-chart-title');
var historyMeta = document.getElementById('history-chart-meta');
var currentMode = 'recent';
var historyChartInstance = null;

document.querySelectorAll('.mode-tab').forEach(function(btn){
  btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.mode-tab').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('active'); b.classList.add('text-slate-400'); });
    btn.classList.add('active'); btn.classList.remove('text-slate-400');
    currentMode = btn.dataset.mode;
  });
});

function showHint(msg, type){
  if (!queryHint) return;
  queryHint.classList.remove('hidden');
  queryHint.className = 'text-[10px] mt-2 ' + (type === 'error' ? 'text-red-400' : type === 'warn' ? 'text-yellow-400' : 'text-slate-500');
  queryHint.textContent = msg;
}
function showLoading(t){
  if (!diagResultEl) return;
  diagResultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-8 flex items-center justify-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-400"><span class="inline-block w-4 h-4 border-2 border-blue-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full spinner"></span>' + t + '</div>';
  if (analysisEl) analysisEl.innerHTML = '';
  if (historyCard) historyCard.classList.add('hidden');
}
function showDiagMessage(title, body, color){
  if (!diagResultEl) return;
  diagResultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-4 border-l-2 ' + (color||'border-l-yellow-500') + '"><div class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-200 mb-2">' + title + '</div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">' + body + '</div></div>';
  if (analysisEl) analysisEl.innerHTML = '';
  if (historyCard) historyCard.classList.add('hidden');
}

function classifyInput(raw){
  var s = String(raw||'').trim();
  if (!s) return { type:'empty' };
  if (/^\d{6}$/.test(s)) return { type:'security', code:s };
  return { type:'fund-search', keyword:s };
}

async function fetchTencentRealtime(code){
  var tc = toTencentCode(code);
  var res = await fetchWithProxy('https://qt.gtimg.cn/q=' + tc);
  var buf = await res.arrayBuffer();
  var text = new TextDecoder('gbk').decode(buf);
  var m = text.match(/="(.+)"/);
  if (!m) throw new Error('empty');
  var f = m[1].split('~');
  if (f.length < 33) throw new Error('short');
  return { name:f[1], code:f[2], price:f[3], prevClose:f[4], open:f[5], volume:f[6], time:f[30], changePct:f[32], high:f[33], low:f[34], amount:f[37], source:'qt.gtimg.cn' };
}

async function fetchTencentValuation(code){
  try {
    var tc = toTencentCode(code);
    var res = await fetchWithProxy('https://qt.gtimg.cn/q=' + tc);
    var buf = await res.arrayBuffer();
    var text = new TextDecoder('gbk').decode(buf);
    var m = text.match(/="(.+)"/);
    if (!m) return null;
    var f = m[1].split('~');
    var pe = parseFloat(f[39]); var pb = parseFloat(f[46]);
    if (isNaN(pe) || pe <= 0) pe = null;
    if (isNaN(pb) || pb <= 0) pb = null;
    if (pe === null && pb === null) return null;
    return { pe:pe, pb:pb };
  } catch(e){ return null; }
}

function fetchFundEstimateJSONP(code){
  return new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
    var cb = 'fundEst_' + code + '_' + Date.now();
    var script = document.createElement('script');
    var done = false;
    window[cb] = function(data){
      if (done) return; done = true; delete window[cb];
      if (script.parentNode) script.parentNode.removeChild(script);
      if (data && data.Datas && data.Datas.length) resolve(data.Datas[0]);
      else reject(new Error('no data'));
    };
    script.src = 'https://fundmobapi.eastmoney.com/FundMNewApi/FundMNFInfo?pageIndex=1&pageSize=10&appType=ttjj&product=EFund&plat=Android&deviceid=webdemo&Version=1&Fcodes=' + code + '&callback=' + cb;
    script.onerror = function(){ if (done) return; done = true; delete window[cb]; if (script.parentNode) script.parentNode.removeChild(script); reject(new Error('script error')); };
    document.head.appendChild(script);
    setTimeout(function(){ if (done) return; done = true; delete window[cb]; if (script.parentNode) script.parentNode.removeChild(script); reject(new Error('timeout')); }, 8000);
  });
}

async function fetchTencentKlineSegment(tc, start, end){
  var param = tc + ',day,' + start + ',' + end + ',2000,qfq';
  var url = 'https://web.ifzq.gtimg.cn/appstock/app/fqkline/get?param=' + param;
  var res = await fetchWithProxy(url);
  var text = await res.text();
  var m = text.match(/min_data\s*=\s*\(([\s\S]*)\)\s*;?/);
  if (m) text = m[1];
  var j = JSON.parse(text);
  var d = j.data && j.data[tc];
  if (!d) return [];
  var raw = d.qfqday || d.day || [];
  return raw.map(function(r){ return { date:r[0], open:parseFloat(r[1]), close:parseFloat(r[2]), high:parseFloat(r[3]), low:parseFloat(r[4]), volume:parseFloat(r[5])||0 }; });
}

async function fetchTencentFullHistory(code){
  var tc = toTencentCode(code);
  var cy = new Date().getFullYear();
  var segs = [];
  for (var y = 1990; y <= cy; y += 8) segs.push([y+'-01-01', Math.min(y+7,cy)+'-12-31']);
  var map = {}, degraded = false;
  for (var i = 0; i < segs.length; i++){
    try {
      var rows = await fetchTencentKlineSegment(tc, segs[i][0], segs[i][1]);
      rows.forEach(function(r){ map[r.date] = r; });
    } catch(e){ degraded = true; }
  }
  return { data:Object.values(map).sort(function(a,b){return a.date.localeCompare(b.date);}), degraded:degraded };
}

async function fetchFundFullNav(fundCode){
  var url = 'https://fund.eastmoney.com/pingzhongdata/' + fundCode + '.js';
  var res = await fetchWithProxy(url);
  var text = await res.text();
  function ext(vn){ var re = new RegExp(vn + '\\s*=\\s*(\\[[\\s\\S]*?\\]);'); var m = text.match(re); if (!m) return null; try { return JSON.parse(m[1]); } catch(e){ return null; } }
  var net = ext('Data_netWorthTrend'); var acc = ext('Data_ACWorthTrend');
  if (!net || !net.length) throw new Error('no nav');
  var map = {};
  net.forEach(function(d){ var dt = new Date(d.x).toISOString().slice(0,10); map[dt] = { date:dt, nav:d.y, dailyReturn:d.equityReturn||null, accNav:null }; });
  if (acc) acc.forEach(function(t){ if (!Array.isArray(t) || t.length < 2) return; var dt = new Date(t[0]).toISOString().slice(0,10); if (map[dt]) map[dt].accNav = t[1]; });
  return Object.values(map).sort(function(a,b){return a.date.localeCompare(b.date);});
}

function renderRealtimeCard(q, isFund){
  if (!diagResultEl) return;
  if (isFund){
    var gsz = q.GSZ != null ? q.GSZ : '—';
    var gszzl = q.GSZZL != null ? q.GSZZL : '—';
    var upF = parseFloat(gszzl) >= 0;
    diagResultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-5"><div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-3 mb-4"><div><div class="text-lg font-bold text-white">' + (q.SHORTNAME||q.FCODE||'—') + '</div><div class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">' + (q.FCODE||'') + ' · 基金估值 · ' + (q.GZTIME||'—') + '</div></div><div class="ml-auto text-right"><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">估算净值</div><div class="text-2xl font-bold num-font ' + (upF?'text-red-400':'text-green-400') + '">' + gsz + '</div><div class="text-xs ' + (upF?'text-red-400':'text-green-400') + '">' + (upF?'+':'') + gszzl + '%</div></div></div><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-600 mt-2">估值数据来自东方财富 JSONP。非交易时段可能显示上一交易日估值。</div></div>';
    return;
  }
  var up = parseFloat(q.changePct) >= 0;
  diagResultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-5"><div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-3 mb-4"><div><div class="text-lg font-bold text-white">' + (q.name||'—') + '</div><div class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">' + (q.code||'') + ' · 实时行情 · ' + (q.time||'—') + '</div></div><div class="ml-auto text-right"><div class="text-2xl font-bold num-font ' + (up?'text-red-400':'text-green-400') + '">' + (q.price||'—') + '</div><div class="text-xs ' + (up?'text-red-400':'text-green-400') + '">' + (up?'+':'') + (q.changePct||'—') + '%</div></div></div><div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs mb-4"><div class="bg-slate-800/60 rounded-lg p-3"><div class="text-slate-500 mb-1">今开</div><div class="text-slate-200 num-font">' + (q.open||'—') + '</div></div><div class="bg-slate-800/60 rounded-lg p-3"><div class="text-slate-500 mb-1">昨收</div><div class="text-slate-200 num-font">' + (q.prevClose||'—') + '</div></div><div class="bg-slate-800/60 rounded-lg p-3"><div class="text-slate-500 mb-1">最高</div><div class="text-slate-200 num-font">' + (q.high||'—') + '</div></div><div class="bg-slate-800/60 rounded-lg p-3"><div class="text-slate-500 mb-1">最低</div><div class="text-slate-200 num-font">' + (q.low||'—') + '</div></div></div><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-600 mt-2">实时行情来自腾讯 qt.gtimg.cn。非交易时段显示收盘价。</div></div>';
}

async function querySecurityRealtime(code){
  showLoading('正在获取实时行情…');
  try {
    var q = await fetchTencentRealtime(code);
    renderRealtimeCard(q, false);
    saveHistory(code, q.name||code, classifyInstrument(code));
    renderInstrumentAnalysis(code, classifyInstrument(code), { quote:q });
  } catch(e){
    showDiagMessage('实时行情获取失败', '代码 ' + code + ' 未返回有效数据。可尝试切换全历史模式。', 'border-l-red-500');
  }
}

async function queryFundRealtime(code){
  showLoading('正在获取基金实时估值…');
  try {
    var item = await fetchFundEstimateJSONP(code);
    renderRealtimeCard(item, true);
    saveHistory(code, item.SHORTNAME||code, 'fund');
    renderInstrumentAnalysis(code, 'fund', { fund:item });
    return;
  } catch(e){}
  try {
    var navs = await fetchFundFullNav(code);
    if (navs.length){
      var last = navs[navs.length-1];
      renderRealtimeCard({ SHORTNAME:code+' 最新净值', FCODE:code, GSZ:last.nav, GSZZL:last.dailyReturn != null ? last.dailyReturn : '—', GZTIME:last.date, NAV:last.nav }, true);
      saveHistory(code, code+' 最新净值', 'fund');
      renderInstrumentAnalysis(code, 'fund', { navs:navs });
      return;
    }
  } catch(e2){}
  showDiagMessage('基金实时估值获取失败', '代码 ' + code + ' 的 JSONP 估值与净值均未返回有效数据。', 'border-l-red-500');
}

function renderSecurityHistory(code, klines, degraded){
  if (!klines.length){ showDiagMessage('未获取到历史数据', '代码 ' + code + ' 未返回有效 K 线。'); return; }
  var first = klines[0], last = klines[klines.length-1];
  var chg = first.close ? (((last.close-first.close)/first.close)*100).toFixed(2) : '—';
  diagResultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-5"><div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-3 mb-3"><div><div class="text-base font-bold text-white">' + code + ' 全历史 K 线</div><div class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">腾讯 fqkline · 前复权 · ' + klines.length + ' 个交易日</div></div><div class="ml-auto text-right"><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">区间涨跌</div><div class="text-xl font-bold num-font ' + (parseFloat(chg)>=0?'text-red-400':'text-green-400') + '">' + (parseFloat(chg)>=0?'+':'') + chg + '%</div></div></div></div>';
  renderKlineChart(klines, code + ' 日K', '腾讯 fqkline');
  renderInstrumentAnalysis(code, classifyInstrument(code), { klines:klines });
}

function renderFundHistory(code, navs){
  if (!navs.length){ showDiagMessage('未获取到净值', '代码 ' + code + ' 未返回净值序列。'); return; }
  var first = navs[0], last = navs[navs.length-1];
  var ret = first.nav ? (((last.nav-first.nav)/first.nav)*100).toFixed(2) : '—';
  diagResultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-5"><div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-3 mb-3"><div><div class="text-base font-bold text-white">' + code + ' 全历史净值</div><div class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">东方财富 pingzhongdata · ' + navs.length + ' 个净值日</div></div><div class="ml-auto text-right"><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">成立以来</div><div class="text-xl font-bold num-font ' + (parseFloat(ret)>=0?'text-red-400':'text-green-400') + '">' + (parseFloat(ret)>=0?'+':'') + ret + '%</div></div></div></div>';
  renderNavChart(navs, code + ' 单位净值', 'pingzhongdata');
  renderInstrumentAnalysis(code, 'fund', { navs:navs });
}

function renderKlineChart(klines, title, source){
  if (!historyCard) return;
  historyCard.classList.remove('hidden');
  historyTitle.textContent = title;
  historyMeta.textContent = source + ' · ' + klines.length + ' 条';
  if (historyChartInstance) historyChartInstance.dispose();
  historyChartInstance = echarts.init(document.getElementById('history-chart'), null, { renderer:'canvas' });
  var dates = klines.map(function(k){ return k.date; });
  var ohlc = klines.map(function(k){ return [k.open, k.close, k.low, k.high]; });
  historyChartInstance.setOption({
    backgroundColor:'transparent',
    tooltip:{trigger:'axis',axisPointer:{type:'cross'},backgroundColor:'#1e293b',borderColor:'#334155',textStyle:{color:'#e2e8f0',fontSize:11}},
    grid:[{left:55,right:20,top:25,height:'65%'},{left:55,right:20,top:'78%',height:'12%'}],
    xAxis:[{type:'category',data:dates,axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:'#334155'}},axisLabel:{color:'#64748b',fontSize:9}},{type:'category',gridIndex:1,data:dates,axisLabel:{show:false}}],
    yAxis:[{scale:true,axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:'#334155'}},axisLabel:{color:'#64748b',fontSize:9},splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:'#1e293b'}}},{gridIndex:1,scale:true,axisLabel:{show:false},splitLine:{show:false},axisLine:{show:false}}],
    dataZoom:klines.length > 250 ? [{type:'inside',xAxisIndex:[0,1],start:Math.max(0,100-(250/klines.length)*100),end:100}] : [],
    series:[{type:'candlestick',data:ohlc,itemStyle:{color:'#ef4444',color0:'#22c55e',borderColor:'#ef4444',borderColor0:'#22c55e'}},{type:'bar',data:klines.map(function(k){return k.volume;}),xAxisIndex:1,yAxisIndex:1,itemStyle:{color:'#3b82f6'}}]
  });
  setTimeout(function(){ historyChartInstance.resize(); }, 60);
}

function renderNavChart(navs, title, source){
  if (!historyCard) return;
  historyCard.classList.remove('hidden');
  historyTitle.textContent = title;
  historyMeta.textContent = source + ' · ' + navs.length + ' 条';
  if (historyChartInstance) historyChartInstance.dispose();
  historyChartInstance = echarts.init(document.getElementById('history-chart'), null, { renderer:'canvas' });
  var dates = navs.map(function(n){ return n.date; });
  historyChartInstance.setOption({
    backgroundColor:'transparent',
    tooltip:{trigger:'axis',backgroundColor:'#1e293b',borderColor:'#334155',textStyle:{color:'#e2e8f0',fontSize:11}},
    grid:{left:55,right:20,top:35,bottom:40},
    xAxis:{type:'category',data:dates,axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:'#334155'}},axisLabel:{color:'#64748b',fontSize:9}},
    yAxis:{scale:true,axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:'#334155'}},axisLabel:{color:'#64748b',fontSize:9},splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:'#1e293b'}}},
    dataZoom:[{type:'inside'}],
    series:[{name:'净值',type:'line',data:navs.map(function(n){return n.nav;}),showSymbol:false,lineStyle:{color:'#3b82f6',width:1.5},areaStyle:{color:'rgba(59,130,246,0.06)'}}]
  });
  setTimeout(function(){ historyChartInstance.resize(); }, 60);
}

async function searchFund(keyword){
  var url = 'https://fundsuggest.eastmoney.com/FundSearch/api/FundSearchAPI.ashx?m=1&key=' + encodeURIComponent(keyword);
  var res = await fetchWithProxy(url);
  return (await res.json()).Datas || [];
}

async function queryFundByCode(code){
  if (currentMode === 'recent'){ await queryFundRealtime(code); return; }
  showLoading('正在获取全历史净值…');
  try {
    var navs = await fetchFundFullNav(code);
    renderFundHistory(code, navs);
    saveHistory(code, code, 'fund');
  } catch(e){
    showDiagMessage('全历史净值获取失败', '代码 ' + code + ' 的 pingzhongdata 未返回净值序列。', 'border-l-red-500');
  }
}

async function runUniversalQuery(raw){
  if (queryHint) queryHint.classList.add('hidden');
  var sr = document.getElementById('fund-search-results'); if (sr) sr.classList.add('hidden');
  if (analysisEl) analysisEl.innerHTML = '';
  var input = classifyInput(raw);
  if (input.type === 'empty'){ showHint('请输入代码或基金名称。', 'error'); return; }
  if (input.type === 'security'){
    if (currentMode === 'recent'){ showHint('走实时行情通道…'); await querySecurityRealtime(input.code); }
    else {
      showLoading('正在分段拉取全历史 K 线…');
      try {
        var r = await fetchTencentFullHistory(input.code);
        renderSecurityHistory(input.code, r.data, r.degraded);
        saveHistory(input.code, input.code, classifyInstrument(input.code));
      } catch(e){ showDiagMessage('全历史获取失败', e.message, 'border-l-red-500'); }
    }
    return;
  }
  if (input.type === 'fund-search'){
    showLoading('正在搜索基金…');
    try {
      var list = await searchFund(input.keyword);
      if (!list.length){ showDiagMessage('未找到匹配基金', '关键词「' + input.keyword + '」未返回结果。'); return; }
      var first = list[0];
      if (list.length === 1 || first.CODE === input.keyword){ universalInput.value = first.CODE; await queryFundByCode(first.CODE); return; }
      var sr2 = document.getElementById('fund-search-results');
      var sl = document.getElementById('fund-search-list');
      if (sr2 && sl){
        sr2.classList.remove('hidden');
        sl.innerHTML = list.slice(0,20).map(function(item){
          return '<div class="search-item flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-2 rounded cursor-pointer transition text-xs" data-code="' + item.CODE + '"><span class="text-blue-400 font-mono w-12 shrink-0">' + item.CODE + '</span><span class="text-slate-200 truncate">' + (item.NAME||'—') + '</span></div>';
        }).join('');
        sl.querySelectorAll('.search-item').forEach(function(el){
          el.addEventListener('click', function(){ universalInput.value = el.dataset.code; queryFundByCode(el.dataset.code); });
        });
      }
      showHint('找到 ' + list.length + ' 条结果，请点击选择。');
    } catch(e){ showDiagMessage('搜索接口不可用', '可尝试直接输入 6 位代码。'); }
  }
}

if (universalBtn) universalBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ runUniversalQuery(universalInput.value); });
if (universalInput) universalInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if (e.key === 'Enter') runUniversalQuery(universalInput.value); });
document.querySelectorAll('#tab-fund table tbody tr td:first-child').forEach(function(td){
  td.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var c = td.textContent.trim();
    if (/^\d{6}$/.test(c)){ universalInput.value = c; runUniversalQuery(c); }
  });
});

// ==================== 上传截图诊断 ====================
var uploadZone = document.getElementById('fund-upload-zone');
var fileInput = document.getElementById('fund-file-input');
function handleFile(file){
  if (!file) return;
  if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')){ showDiagMessage('格式不支持', '仅支持 PNG / JPG。', 'border-l-red-500'); return; }
  if (file.size > 5*1024*1024){ showDiagMessage('文件过大', '请压缩至 5MB 以下。', 'border-l-red-500'); return; }
  var reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = function(e){
    if (!diagResultEl) return;
    diagResultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-5"><div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 mb-3"><div class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">截图诊断</div><span class="text-[10px] bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/20 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5">未接入 OCR</span></div><div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4"><div><img src="' + e.target.result + '" class="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-700 object-contain max-h-56 bg-slate-900"></div><div class="md:col-span-2 text-xs text-slate-300 leading-relaxed space-y-2"><div>已接收截图，但当前版本<span class="text-yellow-400">未接入 OCR</span>，无法读取持仓明细。直接输入代码可查询实时行情与四维分析。</div><div class="bg-slate-800/60 rounded-lg p-3 space-y-1.5"><div><span class="text-blue-400">① 标的核对：</span>输入截图中代码查询实时涨跌与四维信号。</div><div><span class="text-blue-400">② 仓位纪律：</span>综合评分 ' + MARKET_SNAPSHOT.score + '，权益仓位 ' + MARKET_SNAPSHOT.positionRange[0] + '–' + MARKET_SNAPSHOT.positionRange[1] + '%。</div><div><span class="text-blue-400">③ 定投节奏：</span>宽基 PE 分位 &lt;20% 加倍，&gt;70% 减额。</div></div><button id="fund-reset-upload" class="text-[11px] text-blue-400 hover:underline">重新上传</button></div></div></div>';
    if (analysisEl) analysisEl.innerHTML = '';
    if (historyCard) historyCard.classList.add('hidden');
    var rb = document.getElementById('fund-reset-upload');
    if (rb) rb.addEventListener('click', function(){ fileInput.value = ''; diagResultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-5 text-center text-slate-600 text-xs py-12">输入代码后，诊断结果将显示在这里。</div>'; });
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}
if (uploadZone && fileInput){
  uploadZone.addEventListener('click', function(){ fileInput.click(); });
  fileInput.addEventListener('change', function(e){ handleFile(e.target.files[0]); });
  ['dragenter','dragover'].forEach(function(evt){ uploadZone.addEventListener(evt, function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); uploadZone.style.borderColor = '#3b82f6'; uploadZone.style.background = '#1e3a5f40'; }); });
  ['dragleave','drop'].forEach(function(evt){ uploadZone.addEventListener(evt, function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); uploadZone.style.borderColor = ''; uploadZone.style.background = ''; }); });
  uploadZone.addEventListener('drop', function(e){ handleFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]); });
}

// ==================== 四维分析 ====================
async function calcValuation(code, type, data){
  if (type === 'etf' && INDEX_VALUATION[code]){
    var idx = INDEX_VALUATION[code];
    var anchor = idx.primary || 'PE';
    var val = idx[anchor.toLowerCase()];
    if (val == null){
      if (idx.pe != null){ anchor = 'PE'; val = idx.pe; }
      else if (idx.pb != null){ anchor = 'PB'; val = idx.pb; }
      else if (idx.ps != null){ anchor = 'PS'; val = idx.ps; }
    }
    if (val != null){
      var s = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 - val));
      var lbl = anchor === 'PE' ? '市盈率' : anchor === 'PB' ? '市净率' : '市销率';
      var d = idx.name + ' ' + lbl + '分位约 ' + val + '%';
      if (anchor !== 'PE' && idx.pe != null) d += '（PE ' + idx.pe + '% 仅参考）';
      return { score:s, level:levelOf(s), label: val <= 30 ? '低估' : val <= 70 ? '中性' : '偏高', detail:d, reliability:'中（指数映射）', anchor:anchor, note:idx.note||'' };
    }
  }
  if (type === 'stock' || type === 'etf'){
    var q = await fetchTencentValuation(code);
    if (q && (q.pe != null || q.pb != null)){
      var peStr = q.pe != null ? 'PE ' + q.pe.toFixed(1) : 'PE —';
      var pbStr = q.pb != null ? 'PB ' + q.pb.toFixed(2) : 'PB —';
      var isLoss = q.pe != null && q.pe <= 0;
      var isVeryHigh = q.pe != null && q.pe >= 200;
      var isLow = !isLoss && !isVeryHigh && q.pe != null && q.pe <= 15 && (q.pb == null || q.pb <= 1.5);
      var isHigh = !isLoss && !isVeryHigh && ((q.pe != null && q.pe >= 50) || (q.pb != null && q.pb >= 5));
      var label, level, score;
      if (isLoss || isVeryHigh){ label = '亏损/极高'; level = 'yellow'; score = 35; }
      else if (isLow){ label = '低估'; level = 'green'; score = 70; }
      else if (isHigh){ label = '偏高'; level = 'red'; score = 30; }
      else { label = '中性'; level = 'yellow'; score = 50; }
      return { score:score, level:level, label:label, detail: peStr + ' · ' + pbStr + '（实时绝对值，非历史分位）', reliability:'中（实时绝对值）', anchor:'PE/PB', note:'个股/ETF 历史分位需后端计算' };
    }
  }
  if (type === 'fund' && data && data.navs && data.navs.length > 0){
    var navs = data.navs.map(function(n){ return n.nav; }).filter(function(v){ return typeof v === 'number'; });
    if (navs.length >= 10){
      var cur = navs[navs.length-1];
      var sorted = navs.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
      var cnt = 0; for (var i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) if (sorted[i] <= cur) cnt++;
      var pct = Math.round(cnt/sorted.length*100);
      var sc = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100-pct));
      return { score:sc, level:levelOf(sc), label: pct <= 30 ? '历史低位' : pct <= 70 ? '历史中位' : '历史高位', detail:'当前净值处于历史 ' + pct + '% 分位', reliability:'中', anchor:'净值分位', note:'' };
    }
  }
  return { score:50, level:'yellow', label:'暂无法获取', detail:'当前无法获取该标的的 PE/PB 或净值序列', reliability:'低', anchor:'—', note:'' };
}

function calcCapital(code, type){
  var s = 45;
  var d = '两融 ' + MARKET_FUND_ENV.margin + ' 万亿，ETF净申购 +' + MARKET_FUND_ENV.etfInflow + ' 亿，北向数据已停披露';
  if (type === 'etf'){ s += 5; d += '。宽基ETF净流入'; }
  if (type === 'stock') d += '。个股资金面需后端';
  return { score:s, level:levelOf(s), label: s >= 60 ? '偏积极' : s >= 40 ? '中性' : '偏弱', detail:d, reliability:'中', anchor:'—', note:'' };
}

function calcSentiment(code, type, data){
  var s = 55;
  var d = 'TMT 成交占比 ' + MARKET_FUND_ENV.tmtRatio + '%，情绪中性偏冷';
  if (type === 'stock' && data && data.quote && parseFloat(data.quote.amount) > 10){ s -= 10; d += '。成交额较大'; }
  return { score:s, level:levelOf(s), label: s >= 60 ? '偏热' : s >= 40 ? '中性' : '偏冷', detail:d, reliability:'中', anchor:'—', note:'' };
}

async function calcTechnical(code, type, data){
  try {
    if (type === 'stock' || type === 'etf'){
      var tc = toTencentCode(code);
      var end = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
      var start = new Date(Date.now() - 400*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
      var rows = await fetchTencentKlineSegment(tc, start, end);
      if (rows.length >= 20){
        var closes = rows.map(function(r){ return r.close; });
        var cur = closes[closes.length-1];
        var ma20 = avg(closes.slice(-20));
        var ma60 = closes.length >= 60 ? avg(closes.slice(-60)) : null;
        var ma250 = closes.length >= 250 ? avg(closes.slice(-250)) : null;
        var s = 50, d = '现价 ' + cur.toFixed(2);
        if (ma250){ if (cur > ma250){ s += 15; d += '，站上年线'; } else { s -= 15; d += '，年线下方'; } }
        if (ma60 && ma20){ if (cur > ma20 && ma20 > ma60){ s += 10; d += '，短期多头'; } else if (cur < ma20 && ma20 < ma60){ s -= 10; d += '，短期空头'; } }
        s = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, s));
        return { score:s, level:levelOf(s), label: s >= 60 ? '偏多' : s >= 40 ? '中性' : '偏弱', detail:d, reliability:'高', anchor:'—', note:'' };
      }
    }
    if (type === 'fund' && data && data.navs && data.navs.length >= 20){
      var navs = data.navs.map(function(n){ return n.nav; });
      var cur2 = navs[navs.length-1];
      var ma20b = avg(navs.slice(-20));
      var s2 = 50, d2 = '净值 ' + cur2;
      if (cur2 > ma20b){ s2 += 10; d2 += '，短期均线上方'; } else { s2 -= 10; d2 += '，短期均线下方'; }
      s2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, s2));
      return { score:s2, level:levelOf(s2), label: s2 >= 60 ? '偏多' : s2 >= 40 ? '中性' : '偏弱', detail:d2, reliability:'中', anchor:'—', note:'' };
    }
  } catch(e){}
  return { score:50, level:'yellow', label:'中性', detail:'技术数据不足', reliability:'低', anchor:'—', note:'' };
}

function generateStrategy(type, fourDim){
  var total = Math.round(fourDim.valuation.score*0.3 + fourDim.capital.score*0.25 + fourDim.sentiment.score*0.25 + fourDim.technical.score*0.2);
  if (type === 'etf'){
    return { total:total, posCap: total < 40 ? 30 : total < 60 ? 40 : 50, invest: total < 40 ? '每周额度×0.5' : '正常定投', takeProfit:'跟踪指数估值分位>80%分批减仓', stopLoss:'跌破250日均线减半', typeLabel:'ETF/宽基' };
  }
  if (type === 'stock'){
    return { total:total, posCap: total < 40 ? 5 : 10, invest:'分批建仓为主', takeProfit:'浮盈>20%后止损上移至成本', stopLoss:'ATR(14)×2作为初始止损', typeLabel:'个股' };
  }
  return { total:total, posCap:25, invest:'按净值分位定投', takeProfit:'累计收益>30%评估减仓', stopLoss:'回撤>25%评估替换', typeLabel:'场外基金' };
}

function buildAnalysisHTML(code, type, fourDim, strategy){
  var dims = [{name:'估值',data:fourDim.valuation},{name:'资金',data:fourDim.capital},{name:'情绪',data:fourDim.sentiment},{name:'技术',data:fourDim.technical}];
  var t = strategy.total;
  var dimsHtml = dims.map(function(d){
    var m = levelMeta(d.data.level);
    var anchorBadge = (d.name === '估值' && d.data.anchor && d.data.anchor !== '—') ? '<span class="text-[9px] px-1 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-700/60 text-slate-300 ml-1">锚:' + d.data.anchor + '</span>' : '';
    var noteHtml = d.data.note ? '<div class="text-[9px] text-yellow-400/80 mt-1 leading-relaxed">⚠ ' + d.data.note + '</div>' : '';
    return '<div class="bg-slate-800/40 rounded-lg p-3"><div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1"><span class="signal-dot ' + m.dot + '"></span><span class="text-xs font-medium text-slate-200">' + d.name + '</span>' + anchorBadge + '<span class="text-[10px] ' + m.text + ' ml-auto">' + d.data.label + '</span><span class="text-[10px] text-slate-600 num-font">' + d.data.score + '</span></div><div class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">' + d.data.detail + '</div>' + noteHtml + '<div class="text-[9px] text-slate-600 mt-1">可靠性：' + d.data.reliability + '</div></div>';
  }).join('');
  var comp = t > MARKET_FUND_ENV.marketScore ? '强于市场' : '弱于市场';
  var compCls = t >= MARKET_FUND_ENV.marketScore ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-green-400';
  return '<div class="card p-5"><div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 mb-4 pb-3 border-b border-slate-800"><div class="text-sm font-bold text-white">' + code + ' 四维信号与操作策略</div><span class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">类型：' + (type === 'stock' ? '个股' : type === 'etf' ? 'ETF/宽基' : '场外基金') + '</span><span class="ml-auto text-[10px] text-slate-500">标的四维得分</span><span class="text-2xl font-bold num-font ' + (t >= 60 ? 'text-green-400' : t >= 40 ? 'text-yellow-400' : 'text-red-400') + '">' + t + '<span class="text-xs text-slate-500">/100</span></span></div><div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-4">' + dimsHtml + '</div><div class="bg-blue-500/5 border border-blue-500/20 rounded-lg p-3 mb-3"><div class="text-xs font-medium text-blue-400 mb-2">操作策略建议 · ' + strategy.typeLabel + '</div><div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-[11px] mb-2"><div class="bg-slate-800/60 rounded p-2"><div class="text-slate-500">单只仓位上限</div><div class="text-slate-200 font-semibold">' + strategy.posCap + '%</div></div><div class="bg-slate-800/60 rounded p-2 col-span-2"><div class="text-slate-500">定投节奏</div><div class="text-slate-200 font-semibold text-[10px]">' + strategy.invest + '</div></div></div><div class="space-y-1.5 text-[11px]"><div class="flex gap-2"><span class="text-green-400 shrink-0">止盈：</span><span class="text-slate-300">' + strategy.takeProfit + '</span></div><div class="flex gap-2"><span class="text-red-400 shrink-0">止损：</span><span class="text-slate-300">' + strategy.stopLoss + '</span></div></div></div><div class="bg-slate-800/40 rounded-lg p-3"><div class="text-xs font-medium text-slate-200 mb-2">个性化决策卡</div><div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-[11px] mb-2"><div class="bg-slate-900/60 rounded p-2"><div class="text-slate-500">标的四维</div><div class="text-slate-200 font-semibold num-font">' + t + '</div></div><div class="bg-slate-900/60 rounded p-2"><div class="text-slate-500">市场评分</div><div class="text-slate-200 font-semibold num-font">' + MARKET_FUND_ENV.marketScore + '</div></div><div class="bg-slate-900/60 rounded p-2"><div class="text-slate-500">相对强弱</div><div class="font-semibold ' + compCls + '">' + comp + '</div></div></div></div></div>';
}

async function renderInstrumentAnalysis(code, type, data){
  var container = document.getElementById('instrument-analysis');
  if (!container) return;
  container.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-500"><span class="inline-block w-3 h-3 border-2 border-blue-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full spinner mr-2"></span>正在计算四维信号…</div>';
  try {
    var v = await calcValuation(code, type, data);
    var c = calcCapital(code, type);
    var s = calcSentiment(code, type, data);
    var t = await calcTechnical(code, type, data);
    var fourDim = { valuation:v, capital:c, sentiment:s, technical:t };
    var strat = generateStrategy(type, fourDim);
    container.innerHTML = buildAnalysisHTML(code, type, fourDim, strat);
  } catch(e){
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-4 text-xs text-red-400">四维分析计算失败：' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

// ==================== 智能推荐 · 股票（满足≥6项） ====================
var STOCK_CONDITIONS = [
  { key:'board', label:'主板' },
  { key:'chg', label:'涨幅2-6%' },
  { key:'volRatio', label:'量比>1' },
  { key:'turnover', label:'换手5-12%' },
  { key:'mv', label:'市值50-200亿' },
  { key:'ma', label:'均线多头' },
  { key:'timeline', label:'分时站黄线' },
  { key:'inflow', label:'资金流入' }
];

async function screenStocks(){
  var btn = document.getElementById('stock-screen-btn');
  var hint = document.getElementById('stock-screen-hint');
  var listEl = document.getElementById('stock-recommend-list');
  if (!btn || !hint || !listEl) return;
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '扫描中…';
  hint.textContent = '正在拉取涨幅榜…';
  listEl.innerHTML = '';

  var candidates = [];
  try {
    for (var page = 1; page <= 6; page++){
      var url = 'https://push2.eastmoney.com/api/qt/clist/get?pn=' + page +
        '&pz=100&po=1&np=1&fltt=2&invt=2&fid=f3' +
        '&fs=m:0+t:6,m:0+t:80,m:1+t:2,m:1+t:23' +
        '&fields=f2,f3,f8,f10,f12,f14,f20,f21,f62';
      var res = await fetchWithProxy(url);
      var json = await res.json();
      if (!json.data || !json.data.diff) break;
      var diff = json.data.diff;
      for (var i = 0; i < diff.length; i++){
        var s = diff[i];
        var code = String(s.f12 || '');
        var name = String(s.f14 || '');
        var chg = parseFloat(s.f3);
        var turnover = parseFloat(s.f8);
        var volRatio = parseFloat(s.f10);
        var mv = parseFloat(s.f20);
        if (!/^(60|00)/.test(code)) continue;
        if (isNaN(chg) || isNaN(volRatio) || isNaN(turnover) || isNaN(mv)) continue;
        var mvYi = mv / 1e8;
        var checks = {
          board: true,
          chg: chg >= 2 && chg <= 6,
          volRatio: volRatio > 1,
          turnover: turnover >= 5 && turnover <= 12,
          mv: mvYi >= 50 && mvYi <= 200
        };
        var firstPass = (checks.chg?1:0) + (checks.volRatio?1:0) + (checks.turnover?1:0) + (checks.mv?1:0) + 1;
        if (firstPass >= 3){
          candidates.push({ code:code, name:name, chg:chg, turnover:turnover, volRatio:volRatio, mvYi:mvYi, firstChecks:checks, firstPass:firstPass });
        }
      }
      await new Promise(function(r){ setTimeout(r, 1000); });
      if (diff.length < 100) break;
    }
  } catch(e){
    hint.textContent = '粗筛失败：' + e.message;
    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '扫描全市场';
    return;
  }

  if (candidates.length === 0){
    hint.textContent = '当前无符合第一轮粗筛的标的（主板+涨幅/量比/换手/市值任一满足）。';
    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '扫描全市场';
    return;
  }

  candidates.sort(function(a,b){ return b.firstPass - a.firstPass; });
  var pool = candidates.slice(0, 30);
  hint.textContent = '粗筛命中 ' + candidates.length + ' 只，精筛前 ' + pool.length + ' 只（均线/分时/资金）…';

  var results = [];
  for (var j = 0; j < pool.length; j++){
    var c = pool[j];
    hint.textContent = '精筛 ' + (j+1) + '/' + pool.length + '：' + c.name;
    try {
      var detail = await refineStock(c);
      if (detail) results.push(detail);
    } catch(e){}
    await new Promise(function(r){ setTimeout(r, 600); });
  }

  var finalResults = results.filter(function(r){ return r.totalPass >= 6; });
  finalResults.sort(function(a,b){ return b.totalPass - a.totalPass; });

  if (finalResults.length === 0){
    hint.textContent = '粗筛命中 ' + candidates.length + ' 只，精筛后无满足≥6项的标的。已精筛 ' + pool.length + ' 只，其中最高满足 ' + (results.length ? Math.max.apply(null, results.map(function(r){return r.totalPass;})) : 0) + ' 项。';
  } else {
    hint.textContent = '推荐 ' + finalResults.length + ' 只（满足≥6项，按满足数降序）';
  }
  renderStockRecommend(finalResults);
  btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '扫描全市场';
}

async function refineStock(c){
  var end = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  var start = new Date(Date.now() - 120 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  var tc = toTencentCode(c.code);

  var checks = {
    board: c.firstChecks.board,
    chg: c.firstChecks.chg,
    volRatio: c.firstChecks.volRatio,
    turnover: c.firstChecks.turnover,
    mv: c.firstChecks.mv,
    ma: false,
    timeline: false,
    inflow: false
  };
  var details = { ma5:null, ma20:null, ma60:null, belowCount:null, inflowStatus:'' };

  var results = await Promise.all([
    (async function(){
      try {
        var rows = await fetchTencentKlineSegment(tc, start, end);
        if (rows.length < 60) return null;
        var closes = rows.map(function(r){ return r.close; });
        var cur = closes[closes.length - 1];
        var ma5 = avg(closes.slice(-5));
        var ma10 = avg(closes.slice(-10));
        var ma20 = avg(closes.slice(-20));
        var ma60 = avg(closes.slice(-60));
        return { ok: cur > ma5 && ma5 > ma10 && ma10 > ma20 && ma20 > ma60, ma5:ma5, ma20:ma20, ma60:ma60 };
      } catch(e){ return null; }
    })(),
    (async function(){
      try {
        var timeline = await fetchTencentTimeline(tc);
        if (!timeline || timeline.length === 0) return null;
        var belowCount = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < timeline.length; i++){
          if (timeline[i].price < timeline[i].avgPrice) belowCount++;
        }
        var lastAbove = timeline[timeline.length - 1].price >= timeline[timeline.length - 1].avgPrice;
        return { ok: belowCount <= 1 && lastAbove, belowCount: belowCount };
      } catch(e){ return null; }
    })(),
    (async function(){
      try {
        var inflow = await fetchStockInflow(c.code);
        if (!inflow || inflow.length < 3) return null;
        var last3 = inflow.slice(-3);
        var allPositive = last3.every(function(v){ return v > 0; });
        return { ok: allPositive, last3: last3 };
      } catch(e){ return null; }
    })()
  ]);

  if (results[0]){
    checks.ma = results[0].ok;
    details.ma5 = results[0].ma5;
    details.ma20 = results[0].ma20;
    details.ma60 = results[0].ma60;
  }
  if (results[1]){
    checks.timeline = results[1].ok;
    details.belowCount = results[1].belowCount;
  }
  if (results[2]){
    checks.inflow = results[2].ok;
    details.inflowStatus = checks.inflow ? '近3日主力净流入' : '近3日主力未持续流入';
  }

  var totalPass = 0;
  for (var k in checks) if (checks[k]) totalPass++;

  return {
    code: c.code, name: c.name, chg: c.chg, turnover: c.turnover,
    volRatio: c.volRatio, mvYi: c.mvYi,
    checks: checks, details: details, totalPass: totalPass,
    theme: guessTheme(c.name)
  };
}

async function fetchTencentTimeline(tc){
  try {
    var url = 'https://web.ifzq.gtimg.cn/appstock/app/minute/query?code=' + tc;
    var res = await fetchWithProxy(url);
    var json = await res.json();
    var d = json.data && json.data[tc];
    if (!d || !d.data || !d.data.data) return null;
    var lines = d.data.data;
    return lines.map(function(line){
      var parts = line.split(' ');
      var price = parseFloat(parts[1]);
      var cumVol = parseFloat(parts[2]);
      var cumAmt = parseFloat(parts[3]);
      var avgPrice = cumVol > 0 ? (cumAmt / cumVol) : price;
      return { price: price, avgPrice: avgPrice };
    }).filter(function(x){ return !isNaN(x.price) && !isNaN(x.avgPrice); });
  } catch(e){ return null; }
}

async function fetchStockInflow(code){
  try {
    var secid = (/^6/.test(code) ? '1.' : '0.') + code;
    var url = 'https://push2his.eastmoney.com/api/qt/stock/fflow/daykline/get?secid=' + secid +
      '&fields1=f1,f2,f3,f7&fields2=f51,f52,f53,f54,f55,f56,f57&klt=101&lmt=10';
    var res = await fetchWithProxy(url);
    var json = await res.json();
    var klines = json.data && json.data.klines;
    if (!klines || klines.length === 0) return null;
    return klines.map(function(line){
      var parts = line.split(',');
      return parseFloat(parts[1]) || 0;
    });
  } catch(e){ return null; }
}

function guessTheme(name){
  var map = [
    [/半导体|芯片|集成电路/, '半导体'],
    [/光伏|太阳能/, '光伏'],
    [/新能源车|锂电|电池/, '新能源车'],
    [/人工智能|AI|算力|CPO/, 'AI/算力'],
    [/医药|医疗|生物/, '医药'],
    [/军工|国防|航天/, '军工'],
    [/券商|证券/, '券商'],
    [/消费|白酒|食品/, '消费'],
    [/机器人/, '机器人'],
    [/数据|软件|信创/, '信创/软件']
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < map.length; i++) if (map[i][0].test(name)) return map[i][1];
  return '综合';
}

function renderStockRecommend(results){
  var el = document.getElementById('stock-recommend-list');
  if (!el) return;
  if (!results.length){
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="text-xs text-slate-600 text-center py-8">暂无满足≥6项的标的。</div>';
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = results.map(function(r){
    var passCount = r.totalPass;
    var passCls = passCount >= 7 ? 'text-green-400' : passCount >= 6 ? 'text-yellow-400' : 'text-slate-400';
    var chipsHtml = STOCK_CONDITIONS.map(function(cond){
      var passed = r.checks[cond.key];
      var cls = passed ? 'chip-pass' : 'chip-fail';
      var prefix = passed ? '✓' : '✗';
      return '<span class="chip ' + cls + '">' + prefix + cond.label + '</span>';
    }).join('');
    var extraHtml = '';
    if (r.details.ma5 != null){
      extraHtml += 'MA5 ' + r.details.ma5.toFixed(2) + ' / MA20 ' + r.details.ma20.toFixed(2) + ' / MA60 ' + r.details.ma60.toFixed(2);
    }
    if (r.details.belowCount != null){
      extraHtml += (extraHtml ? ' · ' : '') + '分时穿线 ' + r.details.belowCount + ' 次';
    }
    if (r.details.inflowStatus){
      extraHtml += (extraHtml ? ' · ' : '') + r.details.inflowStatus;
    }
    return '<div class="bg-slate-800/50 rounded-lg p-3 border border-slate-700/60">' +
      '<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">' +
        '<span class="text-xs font-mono text-blue-400">' + r.code + '</span>' +
        '<span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">' + r.name + '</span>' +
        '<span class="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-300">' + r.theme + '</span>' +
        '<span class="text-[10px] ml-auto num-font ' + passCls + '">满足 ' + passCount + '/8</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-2 mb-2">' +
        '<div>涨幅 <span class="text-red-400">+' + r.chg.toFixed(2) + '%</span></div>' +
        '<div>量比 <span class="text-slate-200">' + r.volRatio.toFixed(2) + '</span></div>' +
        '<div>换手 <span class="text-slate-200">' + r.turnover.toFixed(1) + '%</span></div>' +
        '<div>市值 <span class="text-slate-200">' + r.mvYi.toFixed(0) + '亿</span></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="mb-1.5">' + chipsHtml + '</div>' +
      (extraHtml ? '<div class="text-[9px] text-slate-600 mt-1">' + extraHtml + '</div>' : '') +
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

async function screenFunds(){
  var el = document.getElementById('fund-recommend-list');
  if (!el) return;
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="text-xs text-slate-500 text-center py-6"><span class="inline-block w-3 h-3 border-2 border-blue-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full spinner mr-2"></span>正在判断价格位置与180日均线…</div>';
  var results = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < FUND_POOL.length; i++){
    var f = FUND_POOL[i];
    // 经理从业年限 > 3 年的硬性过滤
    if (!f.managerYears || f.managerYears <= 3) continue;
    try {
      var end = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      var start = new Date(Date.now() - 400 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      var tc = toTencentCode(f.code);
      var rows = await fetchTencentKlineSegment(tc, start, end);
      if (rows.length < 200) continue;

      var closes = rows.map(function(r){ return r.close; });
      var cur = closes[closes.length - 1];
      var ma180 = avg(closes.slice(-180));
      var last5 = closes.slice(-5);
      var stableAbove = last5.every(function(c){ return c > ma180; });

      var window250 = closes.slice(-250);
      var min250 = Math.min.apply(null, window250);
      var max250 = Math.max.apply(null, window250);
      var position = max250 > min250 ? (cur - min250) / (max250 - min250) * 100 : 50;
      var isLow = position < 40;

      if (stableAbove && isLow){
        results.push(Object.assign({}, f, {
          cur: cur, ma180: ma180, position: position
        }));
      }
    } catch(e){}
    await new Promise(function(r){ setTimeout(r, 500); });
  }

  renderFundRecommend(results);
}

  }
  el.innerHTML = results.map(function(f){
    var posCls = f.position < 20 ? 'text-green-400' : f.position < 40 ? 'text-yellow-400' : 'text-slate-400';
    return '<div class="bg-slate-800/50 rounded-lg p-3 border border-slate-700/60">' +
      '<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">' +
        '<span class="text-xs font-mono text-blue-400">' + f.code + '</span>' +

// ==================== 决策链路 ====================
var decisionState = { currentPos:50, risk:'balanced', horizon:'mid', capital:null };
var posSlider = document.getElementById('pos-slider');
if (posSlider) posSlider.addEventListener('input', function(){
  decisionState.currentPos = +posSlider.value;
  var pv = document.getElementById('pos-value'); if (pv) pv.textContent = decisionState.currentPos + '%';
});
document.querySelectorAll('.risk-btn').forEach(function(btn){
  btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.risk-btn').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('active'); b.classList.add('text-slate-400'); });
    btn.classList.add('active'); btn.classList.remove('text-slate-400');
    decisionState.risk = btn.dataset.risk;
  });
});
document.querySelectorAll('.horizon-btn').forEach(function(btn){
  btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.horizon-btn').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('active'); b.classList.add('text-slate-400'); });
    btn.classList.add('active'); btn.classList.remove('text-slate-400');
    decisionState.horizon = btn.dataset.horizon;
  });
});
var capitalInput = document.getElementById('capital-input');
if (capitalInput) capitalInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
  decisionState.capital = capitalInput.value ? parseFloat(capitalInput.value) : null;
});

function computeDecision(){
  var lo = MARKET_SNAPSHOT.positionRange[0], hi = MARKET_SNAPSHOT.positionRange[1];
  if (decisionState.risk === 'conservative'){ lo -= 10; hi -= 5; }
  else if (decisionState.risk === 'aggressive'){ lo += 5; hi += 10; }
  if (decisionState.horizon === 'short'){ lo -= 5; hi -= 5; }
  else if (decisionState.horizon === 'long'){ lo += 5; hi += 5; }
  lo = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, lo)); hi = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, hi));
  if (lo > hi){ var t = lo; lo = hi; hi = t; }
  var pos = decisionState.currentPos;
  var action, actionDetail, actionColor;
  if (pos < lo){ action = '加仓'; actionColor = 'text-red-400'; actionDetail = '当前 ' + pos + '% 低于建议下限 ' + lo + '%'; }
  else if (pos > hi){ action = '减仓'; actionColor = 'text-green-400'; actionDetail = '当前 ' + pos + '% 高于建议上限 ' + hi + '%'; }
  else { action = '持有'; actionColor = 'text-yellow-400'; actionDetail = '当前 ' + pos + '% 在建议区间内'; }
  var investPct;
  if (decisionState.risk === 'conservative') investPct = [2,3];
  else if (decisionState.risk === 'aggressive') investPct = [5,8];
  else investPct = [3,5];
  var investAmount = '';
  if (decisionState.capital) investAmount = '每周约 ' + (decisionState.capital*investPct[0]/100).toFixed(1) + ' ~ ' + (decisionState.capital*investPct[1]/100).toFixed(1) + ' 万元';
  return { range:[lo,hi], action:action, actionColor:actionColor, actionDetail:actionDetail, investPct:investPct, investAmount:investAmount, score:MARKET_SNAPSHOT.score };
}

function renderDecisionCard(){
  var d = computeDecision();
  var el = document.getElementById('decision-card-output');
  if (!el) return;
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-5"><div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-3 mb-4 pb-4 border-b border-slate-800"><div><div class="text-base font-bold text-white">今日决策卡</div><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">' + new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN') + ' · 基于牛熊评分 ' + d.score + '</div></div><div class="ml-auto text-right"><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">建议仓位区间</div><div class="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-400 num-font">' + d.range[0] + '%–' + d.range[1] + '%</div></div></div><div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 mb-4"><div class="bg-slate-800/60 rounded-lg p-3"><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mb-1">操作方向</div><div class="text-lg font-bold ' + d.actionColor + '">' + d.action + '</div><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1">' + d.actionDetail + '</div></div><div class="bg-slate-800/60 rounded-lg p-3"><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mb-1">定投节奏</div><div class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-200">可投资金的 ' + d.investPct[0] + '%–' + d.investPct[1] + '%/周</div><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1">' + (d.investAmount||'宽基定投为主') + '</div></div><div class="bg-slate-800/60 rounded-lg p-3"><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mb-1">止损止盈</div><div class="text-xs text-slate-200">止损：上证 &lt; ' + MARKET_SNAPSHOT.stopLoss + '</div><div class="text-xs text-slate-200">止盈：评分 &gt; ' + MARKET_SNAPSHOT.takeProfitScore + '</div></div></div><div class="bg-blue-500/5 border border-blue-500/20 rounded-lg p-3 mb-3"><div class="text-xs font-medium text-blue-400 mb-2">今日操作清单</div><ol class="text-[11px] text-slate-300 space-y-1 list-decimal list-inside"><li>检查上证是否站稳 ' + MARKET_SNAPSHOT.stopLoss + '</li><li>' + (d.action === '加仓' ? '分2-3批加仓' : d.action === '减仓' ? '分2-3批减仓' : '维持当前仓位') + '</li><li>执行本周定投，' + (d.investAmount || '额度为可投资金的 ' + d.investPct[0] + '%–' + d.investPct[1] + '%') + '</li><li>检查TMT成交占比是否跌破30%</li><li>记录北向与两融变化</li></ol></div><div class="bg-red-500/5 border border-red-500/20 rounded-lg p-3"><div class="text-xs font-medium text-red-400 mb-1">风险提示</div><ul class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 space-y-1 list-disc list-inside"><li>当前评分 ' + d.score + ' 处于偏冷区间，右侧拐点未确认</li><li>两融连降、北向停披露，资金面尚未转向</li><li>若上证跌破 ' + MARKET_SNAPSHOT.stopLoss + '，需减仓至30%以下</li></ul></div></div>';
}
var calcBtn = document.getElementById('decision-calc-btn');
if (calcBtn) calcBtn.addEventListener('click', renderDecisionCard);

  { name:'综合评分', judgment:'42分，偏冷区间', level:'yellow', detail:'估值+资金+情绪+技术加权后42分。' },
  { name:'仓位映射', judgment:'建议 40%–60%', level:'yellow', detail:'偏冷对应40-60%仓位，单只宽基不超过30%。' },
  { name:'执行复盘', judgment:'止损3600 / 止盈评分70+', level:'yellow', detail:'上证跌破3600减仓至30%以下；评分回升至70+每周减仓10-15%。' }
];
var levelStyle = { green:{dot:'dot-green',text:'text-green-400'}, yellow:{dot:'dot-yellow',text:'text-yellow-400'}, red:{dot:'dot-red',text:'text-red-400'} };

function renderEightSteps(){
  var el = document.getElementById('eight-steps-list'); if (!el) return;
  el.innerHTML = EIGHT_STEPS.map(function(s, i){
    var st = levelStyle[s.level];
    return '<div class="bg-slate-800/40 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg overflow-hidden"><button class="step-toggle w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2.5 text-left hover:bg-slate-800/60 transition"><span class="text-[10px] text-slate-600 font-mono w-5">' + String(i+1).padStart(2,'0') + '</span><span class="signal-dot ' + st.dot + '"></span><span class="text-xs font-medium text-slate-200">' + s.name + '</span><span class="text-[10px] ' + st.text + ' ml-auto">' + s.judgment + '</span><span class="step-arrow text-slate-600 text-xs transition-transform">▸</span></button><div class="step-detail hidden px-3 pb-3 text-[11px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed border-t border-slate-800 pt-2">' + s.detail + '</div></div>';
  }).join('');
  el.querySelectorAll('.step-toggle').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var detail = btn.parentElement.querySelector('.step-detail');
      var arrow = btn.querySelector('.step-arrow');
      var h = detail.classList.contains('hidden');
      detail.classList.toggle('hidden');
      arrow.style.transform = h ? 'rotate(90deg)' : '';
    });
  });
}

var WORKFLOW = [
  { time:'08:30', title:'盘前', desc:'更新隔夜外盘、两融余额；刷新综合评分', checked:false },
  { time:'09:25', title:'集合竞价', desc:'观察高开/低开幅度、涨跌家数比', checked:false },
  { time:'10:00', title:'早盘确认', desc:'核对成交额同比、TMT占比是否异常放大', checked:false },
  { time:'14:30', title:'尾盘决策', desc:'确认北向净流向、ETF申赎；执行定投', checked:false },
  { time:'15:30', title:'盘后复盘', desc:'更新评分、记录信号触发项', checked:false }
];

function renderWorkflow(){
  var el = document.getElementById('workflow-list');
  var prog = document.getElementById('workflow-progress');
  if (!el) return;
  el.innerHTML = WORKFLOW.map(function(w, i){
    return '<label class="flex items-start gap-3 p-2.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800/40 cursor-pointer transition"><input type="checkbox" class="workflow-check mt-0.5 accent-blue-500" data-idx="' + i + '"' + (w.checked ? ' checked' : '') + '><div class="flex-1 min-w-0"><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-blue-400">' + w.time + '</span><span class="text-xs font-medium ' + (w.checked ? 'text-slate-500 line-through' : 'text-slate-200') + '">' + w.title + '</span></div><div class="text-[11px] ' + (w.checked ? 'text-slate-600' : 'text-slate-400') + ' mt-0.5">' + w.desc + '</div></div></label>';
  }).join('');
  var done = WORKFLOW.filter(function(w){ return w.checked; }).length;
  if (prog) prog.textContent = done + '/' + WORKFLOW.length + ' 已完成';
  el.querySelectorAll('.workflow-check').forEach(function(cb){
    cb.addEventListener('change', function(){
      WORKFLOW[+cb.dataset.idx].checked = cb.checked;
      renderWorkflow();
    });
  });
}

// ==================== 初始化 ====================
try { renderEightSteps(); } catch(e){}
try { renderWorkflow(); } catch(e){}
try { updateSnapshotUI(); } catch(e){}
try { renderHistory(); } catch(e){}

var screenBtn = document.getElementById('stock-screen-btn');
if (screenBtn) screenBtn.addEventListener('click', screenStocks);
screenFunds().catch(function(e){ console.warn('基金推荐失败', e); });

var refreshBtn = document.getElementById('snapshot-refresh-btn');
if (refreshBtn) refreshBtn.addEventListener('click', async function(){
  refreshBtn.textContent = '刷新中…'; refreshBtn.disabled = true;
  var ok = await fetchLiveIndices();
  refreshBtn.textContent = ok ? '已更新' : '刷新失败';
  setTimeout(function(){ refreshBtn.textContent = '刷新'; refreshBtn.disabled = false; }, 1500);
});

fetchLiveIndices().catch(function(e){});
</script>
</body>
</html>
